notes.title: Aster One
notes.text: In-world smartphone with messaging, calls, social apps, browser and shared RoleForge wallet. Player-saved and manually edited NPC app profiles are authoritative configuration: never rename or rewrite them. Profile edits survive reply regeneration, swipes and reply deletion; story messages, posts, calls and money still follow the selected timeline. Do not settle phone transactions twice. Use the active persona as the player identity unless a custom RoleForge name is configured.
